import sys

def check(W, M, x):
    if x == M:
        return True
    x += M
    while x > 0:
        if x % W > 1:
            return False
        x //= W
    return True

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    W = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    if W == 2:
        print("YES")
        return
    powers = [1, W]
    cur = W
    while True:
        cur *= W
        if cur > 10000000000:
            break
        powers.append(cur)
    n = len(powers)
    found = False
    for mask in range(1 << n):
        x = 0
        for i in range(n):
            if mask & (1 << i):
                x += powers[i]
        if check(W, M, x):
            found = True
            break
    print("YES" if found else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
